title: 第117章 万次磕首，生生世世
slug: 给你尊荣你不要来世我去娶郡主
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

禅房寂寂，炉烟袅袅。

法回大师整个人枯如古树，静若寒潭。

指间念珠，一颗颗缓缓捻过，数轮回，拨生死。

顾辰的目光，不觉间再度被那暗红珠光牵引。

上一次来，他便觉得此珠浑如活物。

那时只道是酒后有些晕眩，现在他确定，是那一串念珠的其中一枚珠子，在吸引着他。

法回大师取下那一枚念珠，抬手递出。

“顾施主心中有疑。”

顾辰低头，望向那枚珠子。

珠光含晦，裹挟着无数个日夜，无数声呼唤，被碾碎、揉尽、压缩成这一小截木头。

“此珠之中，承载着前世的赵施主。”

“……什么？”

法回大师声色轻缓：

“众生所求，皆为‘我好’。只要持身正，持心纯，来此转灵寺，皆有所得，反之，则遭噬。但无论是好是坏，这山门上所来的人，皆为求财者、求权者、求长寿者、求姻缘者、求阖家欢乐者，诸般所求，皆是为‘我’。”

“唯独赵施主，求的是‘他好’。”

顾辰的手，悬在半空，微微一颤。

“施主若想看，便看吧。”

珠子落入掌心。

那一瞬——

一股前所未有的力量，从指尖钻入骨髓，从手臂窜上心口，从心口涌向眼眶。

一个人在很远很远的地方，似乎在他的名字。

喊了一世，又一世。

他眼前骤然一暗——

天地倾覆，因果回头，是爱人用千次叩首，换了他这一刻低眸。

他看见了安阳。

城墙旧，街道破，县衙门口的槐树还没长大。

他前世的自己，穿着青衫，蹲在田埂上，满手泥巴，跟一个老农说话。

然后他看见了她。

赵红绫骑在枣红马上，红衣如火。

他听见她在说：

“这个人，和别的官不一样。”

这是他前世第一次来安阳。

他治水，她跟着；他治蝗，她看着。

她从来没有走近过。

只是骑在那匹枣红马上，远远地看着那个在泥水里摸爬滚打的县令。

后来，他一步步高升，得了崇圣帝眷顾，成了北境锋州参将，外出戍边。

他穿着甲胄，骑着马，从京城北门出发。

城墙上，一个红色的身影躲在垛口后面，手里攥着一支笛子。

她把笛子举到唇边。

吹了一首出征曲，可那曲子里，她藏了一句没人听见的祈愿。

“顾辰。愿你，百战百胜。”

他又看见她跪在赵府的正厅里，跪在赵泰极和大长公主面前。

“爷爷，娘，我这辈子不嫁人了。”

赵泰极愣着：“你说什么？”

“我这辈子不嫁人了，我的心上人，已经娶了别人。我心里装不下别人了，我也不想委屈自己。请爷爷和娘成全。”

大长公主的眼泪掉了下来。

赵泰极只问了一句：“你决定了？”

她点头。

再后来，她听着前线的战报，那个男人今天又是大捷、斩首。

大乾北境的安宁，他一个人，独力撑了数年。

他看见她一年一年地老去。

鬓边的白发一根一根地多起来，眼角的皱纹一道一道地深下去。

她还在做那些事，施粥，赈灾，路见不平拔剑相助。

她去了很多地方，见了很多人，帮了很多百姓。

直到她更老了，没法出京城了，那支笛子还挂在腰间，那柄长剑只能挂在墙上。

最后，在他死后，他看见她去了转灵寺。

从山脚下一步一步地走上去，走得很慢，走几十步就要歇一歇。

到了寺里。

一个年纪很小的法回小沙弥问她：“施主，求什么？”

“愿顾辰，来世一切都好。”

那法号法回的小沙弥问：“此人对施主，是很重要的人？”

“嗯，比重要还重要。”

小沙弥似乎有些童心，又问：“一求一应，再无二次，施主，可想好了？”

“世间万事万物，唯独此人于我而言，无可比量。我，想好了。”

她跪在佛前，开始磕头。

一个，两个，三个……

因为老了，膝盖不行了，腰也弯不下去了。

她只能磕得慢，但一个都没有少。

她磕了一千个。

最后一个时，她开口笑着说：

“愿顾辰，”

“来世一切都好。”

没有“我”，没有“我们”。

The Zen room was silent, with smoke from the furnace curling up.

Master Fahui's whole body is as dry as an ancient tree and as quiet as a cold pool.

The rosary beads between the fingers are slowly twisted one by one, counting reincarnations and dialing life and death.

Gu Chen's eyes were unknowingly drawn by the dark red pearl light again.

The last time he came, he felt that the pearl was like a living thing.

At that time, he only thought he was dizzy after drinking, but now he was sure that it was one of the beads in the rosary that attracted him.

Master Fahui took off the rosary, raised his hand and handed it out.

"Donor Gu is suspicious."

Gu Chen lowered his head and looked at the bead.

The pearly light is dim, carrying countless days and nights, countless calls, being crushed, kneaded, and compressed into this small piece of wood.

"This bead carries the benefactor Zhao from his previous life."

"...What?"

Master Fahui’s voice was gentle:

"Everything that all sentient beings seek is 'my good'. As long as you keep your body upright and your mind pure, you will gain something from this Zhuanling Temple. Otherwise, you will be devoured. But no matter whether they are good or bad, the people who come to this mountain gate are all seeking wealth, seeking power, seeking longevity, seeking marriage, and seeking happiness for the whole family. All their desires are for 'me'."

"Only Donor Zhao is asking for 'his good'."

Gu Chen's hand was hanging in the air, trembling slightly.

"If the donor wants to see it, he can see it."

The beads fell into the palm of my hand.

That moment——

An unprecedented power penetrated from the fingertips into the bone marrow, rushed from the arms to the heart, and surged from the heart to the eye sockets.

A person is far, far away, and his name seems to be there.

I shouted for one life and another.

His eyes suddenly darkened——

The world collapsed, cause and effect turned around, and it was his lover who kowtowed a thousand times to change his lowered eyes at this moment.

He saw Anyang.

The city walls are old, the streets are dilapidated, and the locust tree at the gate of the county government office has not grown up yet.

In his previous life, he was wearing a green shirt, squatting on the field ridge, his hands full of mud, talking to an old farmer.

Then he saw her.

Zhao Hongling is riding on a maroon horse, her red clothes are like fire.

He heard her say:

"This person is different from other officials."

This was his first time in Anyang in his previous life.

He treats the floods, and she follows; he treats the locusts, and she watches.

She never came close.

I was just riding on that bay-red horse, watching the county magistrate crawling around in the muddy water from a distance.

Later, he rose through the ranks step by step, gained the favor of Emperor Chongsheng, and became the general of Fengzhou in the northern border, where he went out to guard the border.

Wearing armor and riding a horse, he set out from the north gate of the capital.

On the city wall, a red figure was hiding behind the crenels, holding a flute in his hand.

She raised the flute to her lips.

She played a marching song, but in that song, she hid a prayer that no one heard.

"Gu Chen. I wish you victory in every battle."

He saw her kneeling in the main hall of Zhao Mansion again, kneeling in front of Zhao Taiji and the eldest princess.

"Grandpa, mother, I will never marry again in this life."

Zhao Taiji was stunned: "What did you say?"

"I will never marry again in this life. My sweetheart has already married someone else. I can't hold anyone else in my heart, and I don't want to wrong myself. Please make it happen, grandpa and mother."

The eldest princess's tears fell.

Zhao Taiji only asked: "Have you decided?"

She nodded.

Later, she listened to the battle report from the front line. That man had another great victory and beheading today.

He had maintained the peace of the Northern Territory for several years by himself.

He saw her getting older year by year.

The white hairs on the temples grew one by one, and the wrinkles at the corners of the eyes deepened one by one.

She is still doing those things, giving out porridge, providing disaster relief, and drawing her sword to help when there is injustice on the road.

She went to many places, met many people, and helped many people.

Until she got older and could no longer leave the capital, the flute was still hanging on her waist and the long sword could only be hung on the wall.

Finally, after his death, he saw her going to Zhuanling Temple.

We walked up step by step from the foot of the mountain, walking very slowly, taking a break after walking dozens of steps.

Arrived at the temple.

A very young Dharma novice monk asked her: "Donor, what do you ask for?"

"Gu Chen, I wish everything will be fine in the next life."

The young novice monk named Fahui asked: "Is this person very important to the donor?"

"Well, it's more important than that."

The little novice monk seemed to have a childlike innocence, and asked again: "Every request will be answered, never twice. Donor, have you thought about it?"

"All things in the world, but this person is incomparable to me. I have thought about it."

She knelt before the Buddha and began to kowtow.

One, two, three...

Because I am getting old, my knees are no longer good and I can no longer bend my waist.

She could only kowtow slowly, but no one was missing.

She knocked a thousand times.

At the last one, she smiled and said:

"May Gu Chen,"

"Everything will be fine in the next life."

There is no "I", no "we".
